what: Release 0.7.3 rejects default minimal creation and the npm artifact job fails.
expected: Packed relkit, scoped CLI, and create-relkit accept the certified minimal/no jobs/no cloud/no deploy/examples-on tuple for the actual release, retaining rejection of uncertified tuples.
observed: CI and local --ci-pack fail with RELKIT_CREATE_USAGE: none for this tool identity. Capability tests additionally show a stale template digest and missing pre-archive evidence path.
root_cause: packages/create-relkit/src/create-capabilities.ts:49 pinned release 0.7.2 while the package and template manifests were 0.7.3. The template digest was stale too. Tests injected the table identity instead of checking the actual tool identity and read removed pre-archive evidence paths. Artifact building did not validate certification evidence before packing.
fixed_by: Certify the actual 0.7.3 identity and template, keep versioned evidence paths, check the current identity without injection, and validate evidence before building artifacts. The final 20 fresh starts peaked at 777.006458 ms, the 20 restarts at 554.307 ms, and preparation at 685.158291 ms. The full --ci-pack replay, generator suite and prepush passed. Earlier failed sets remain retained. Changes are uncommitted and unpushed.
